description_en: Adds a replication pair to a replication pair-consistent group. You can use a replication pair-consistent group to batch manage replication pairs. When you call this operation, you can specify parameters, such as ReplicaGroupId, ReplicaPairId, and ClientToken, in the request
description_zh: 调用AddDiskReplicaPair接口，并可以指定ReplicaGroupId、ReplicaPairId、ClientToken等参数，添加复制对到一致性复制组，最终通过一致性复制组，您可以批量管理复制对
kebab_example: aliyun ebs add-disk-replica-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id pg-myreplica0000 --replica-pair-id pair-cn-dsa0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
